reason: Drove every reversible action at 1440x960 and 390x844 (owner-flight, editor on Send the invitations) and harvested the bar verbatim. Transcription is accurate: +7 -> "Send the invitations moved 7 days later." (html: ...moved 7 days later.), -1 -> "...moved 1 day earlier.", typed date -> "...moved 33 days later.", rename -> "Renamed to Evening reception.", rename-to-blank -> "Renamed to Untitled moment.", hide -> "...is now hidden from guests.", show -> "...is now shown to guests.", delete -> "Send the invitations was removed.", add -> "A moment was added." Everything else in the finding fails. (1) It is round 8's undo-node-speaks-six-grammars re-cut, and it does not meet that refutation's stated objections. lessons.md:66 reads "One grammar per fact ... one fact (elapsed, deictic, weekday, date). Pick one" - one FACT in four grammars. Here different facts, and hide/show is a different KIND of change: a standing state toggle, correctly present-tense, not an event. That objection is not answered, only restated. (2) The narrow rename claim also fails, and its fix is measurably worse. Measured: at rename the editor's aria-label becomes "Editing Evening reception", the field labelled "What it is" holds "Evening reception", and the rail title is "Evening reception" - the new name is on screen three times; the pre-edit name is on screen nowhere. The proposed "Send the invitations is now Evening reception." therefore makes the subject a string that no longer exists, and it puts TWO undelimited proper names in one sentence where there was one - it worsens the exact defect the finding raises, and its own .b-undoName wrapper only covers the leading name, leaving the value the person just typed as the sole bare one in the entry that is entirely about that value. It also collides with the visibility line it copies: "X is now hidden from guests" predicates a state, "X is now Evening reception" predicates identity, so any state-ish title ("Hidden ceremony") garden-paths worse than today's string. And it kills interaction-check.mjs:850 (/Renamed to/). Driving rename-then-move returns "Evening reception moved 7 days later." - the bar consistently speaks the current name, which is the locatable one. (3) The new typographic half rests on a false premise. The finding says 600 "is already what a person's words get in .b-title". Measured on owner-flight: .b-title is font-weight 400 for every ordinary moment (b.css:273). 600 appears only at b.css:307-308, data-lead and data-anchor - "next up" and "the day" - and b.css:340 explicitly pushes hidden titles back to 400. In this system 600 is a STATUS signal, not a voice signal. Printing every moment's name at 600 in a transient report spends the rail's only weight distinction on a status the moment does not hold; in the hide entry the bar would set the name at 600 in the same instant the rail drops that same title to 400. That is the constraint block's "hierarchy is expressed by ink density, weight and fill" being devalued, not served. (4) It also breaks the bar's own scheme. Measured on owner-undone: the whole bar is one weight (400) with three ink densities - report text at 72%, .b-undoAct at 100% with a 28% underline, kbd at 62%. A 600 word would be the bar's heaviest glyphs sitting at its dimmest density, out-weighing the Undo control, the only element in the bar that does anything. (5) The garden-path premise is weakest on the very frame it cites. owner-undone renders with the editor open, aria-label "Editing Send the invitations", the bar inside it, two rows above a field containing that exact string. And undelimited names in machine sentences is the settled product-wide convention, not a bar anomaly: every Edit control's accessible name reads "Edit Send the invitations. Saturday 8 August, in 23 days. Shown to guests." Changing only the bar would make it the outlier. A broad restatement of a refuted finding, whose one narrow atom was already answered and whose two new proposals each make the artifact worse.
sharpenedFix: Take nothing from this. Leave the five wordings and the single-weight bar as they are. The only atom in this family with merit is the one round 8 already sharpened and it is unrelated to grammar or weight: the control says "Delete this moment" while the bar says "was removed" - if anyone spends a change here, align that single verb ("Send the invitations was deleted.") and update interaction-check.mjs:904 in the same commit. Do not add .b-undoName, do not put 600 in the bar, and do not passivise or re-subject the rename line.
